backend/main.mo: Primary Motoko canister implementing the backend domain logic for forms, dropdowns, reports, entity records, Excel imports, and access control, with persistent storage and admin/user authorization checks.
backend/migration.mo: Defines a state migration module that maps the old actor state to the new actor state, preserving all stored forms, entities, reports, import history, and access control data.
feature_evidence.json: Machine-readable report listing implemented features, their related frontend files, dependencies, test requirements, and confidence levels for Excel workflows and production deployment.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated index of frontend source files with brief descriptions of each component, hook, utility, and documentation file.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration defining light and dark themes using an OKLCH color system, layout variables, and base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the frontend application that mounts the React app and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/PRODUCTION_DEPLOYMENT.md: Step-by-step guide for deploying the application to the Internet Computer mainnet, covering prerequisites, admin bootstrap, deployment commands, verification, and troubleshooting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing authentication, profile setup flow, loading states, theming, and rendering the main dashboard layout.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPanel: Defines the main admin configuration page with tabbed navigation for forms, dropdowns, reports, and settings.
frontend/src/components/admin/DropdownMa: Allows admins to add and view options for predefined dropdown types, fetching and mutating data via query hooks.
frontend/src/components/admin/FormBuilde: UI for creating dynamic form definitions by adding, editing, and ordering fields, then persisting them via backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/admin/ReportBuil: Placeholder interface for report configuration that lists existing reports fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Displays dashboard KPIs and charts for students, enquiries, fees, and attendance using fetched entity data and Recharts visualizations.
frontend/src/components/dialogs/AddEntit: Generic dialog component that dynamically renders a form based on a fetched form definition and submits new entity data via API hooks. Handles loading, missing-form states, and supports multiple field types with validation.
frontend/src/components/excel/ExcelManag: Provides Excel import/export management for entities, including template download, file parsing, validation, and bulk entity creation with status tracking and user feedback. Supports selecting forms and reviewing valid/invalid rows before import.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a simple footer with a copyright notice, heart icon, and external link to caffeine.ai using styled Tailwind classes.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements a sticky application header with branding, logout functionality, and responsive desktop/mobile navigation using a sheet menu.
frontend/src/components/modules/Attendan: Attendance management module that lists, searches, and displays attendance records fetched from the backend. Integrates AddEntityDialog to mark new attendance entries and shows records in a table view.
frontend/src/components/modules/Enquirie: Enquiries management module for viewing, searching, and adding prospective student enquiries. Displays enquiry data in a table and uses AddEntityDialog to create new enquiry records.
frontend/src/components/modules/FeesModu: Fees management module that allows viewing, searching, and recording fee transactions. Fetches fee entities, displays them in a table, and uses AddEntityDialog to add new payment records.
frontend/src/components/modules/ReportsM: Renders a reports and analytics dashboard with predefined report cards and a list of custom reports fetched via useGetAllReports, handling loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/modules/Students: Provides a student management UI with search, table listing, empty states, and an add-student dialog, backed by entity and form data from React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Provides a profile setup form prompting the user for their name and saving an admin profile via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Defines a hook that creates and caches a backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, initializes access control, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, managing login, logout, identity persistence, and detailed login status using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains a large collection of React Query hooks for interacting with backend actors, including user profile, admin checks, forms, dropdowns, entities, reports, and mutations with toast feedback.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind CSS layers and defines extensive CSS variables for light and dark educational themes, including colors, charts, and sidebar styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that creates the React root and wraps App with React Query and Internet Identity providers, importing global styles.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Implements the main dashboard page with a tabbed UI controlling which management module is shown (overview, students, enquiries, fees, attendance, reports, Excel, admin). Manages active tab state and renders the corresponding module component.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Defines the login and landing page for the Preschool LMS, integrating Internet Identity authentication. Presents branding, a login card with loading state, and a feature-focused hero layout.
frontend/src/types/xlsx.d.ts: TypeScript declaration file placeholder for XLSX-related types, likely used to satisfy type checking when working with SheetJS loaded from a CDN.
frontend/src/utils/excelExport.ts: Provides utilities to dynamically load SheetJS and export entity records to Excel. Builds a workbook from form definitions and data, formats timestamps, auto-sizes columns, and triggers file download.
frontend/src/utils/excelImport.ts: Handles importing and parsing Excel files using SheetJS, validating rows against a form definition. Separates valid and invalid rows, performs type coercion and required-field checks, and reports detailed errors.
frontend/src/utils/excelWorkbook.ts: Generates Excel template workbooks based on form definitions, including a data sheet and an instructions sheet. Supports downloading templates and arbitrary workbooks via SheetJS.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading URL parameters from query strings or hash routes and persisting them in sessionStorage. Includes functions to retrieve, store, clear, and sanitize URL parameters without page reloads.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining content paths, dark mode via class, container defaults, and extensive theme extensions for colors (CSS variable–driven OKLCH), radii, shadows, and accordion animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins enabled.
project_state.json: Machine-readable snapshot of the Preschool LMS project describing its architecture, tech stack, and current feature set, including authentication, RBAC, dynamic forms, dropdowns, generic entities, and admin tooling, with versioned feature definitions for planning and tracking.
